result.title: VH-GPO: Verified Handoff for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Group-relative reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO train large language model (LLM) agents by comparing rollouts for the same task. When every trajectory in a group fails with the same reward, relative advantages collapse toward zero, leaving no useful learning signal. A frozen teacher can recover from a student-visited state, but letting it complete the task makes the recovered suffix entirely teacher-generated. We ask: after repairing a student failure, when should control return to the student? We propose outcome-verified teacher-student handoff, instantiated in Verified Handoff for Group Policy Optimization (VH-GPO). The teacher provides enough support to reach a state from which the student can succeed, then returns control so that successful experience is again student-generated. Given an environment-verified teacher recovery, VH-GPO selects the earliest independently confirmed handoff point found within a bounded search budget. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, VH-GPO increases success rates over GRPO from 59.38% to 94.79% on ALFWorld and from 71.62% to 77.34% on WebShop. Improvements also hold with the 7B student, for which additional teacher and student output tokens amount to 1.77% and 2.61% of regular student rollout output tokens on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the key components. These results support using verified teacher assistance to repair failures while reinforcing the student's ability to complete tasks independently.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 VH-GPO：当 GRPO 组内全部轨迹失败、相对优势坍缩为零时，用冻结教师从学生到达的状态修复失败，再借助环境验证选取最早的交接点把控制权交回学生，使成功经验仍由学生生成；在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上提升成功率且额外 token 开销很小。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时把控制权交回学生」的验证式交接涉及轨迹训练中的贡献分配与监督问题，可能为 LVR 中教师辅助与 latent 状态的接管/停止时机提供可供核查的方法线索，但原文是纯文本智能体 RL，未触及视觉或多模态推理。
